title: Enable disabled “Add” tab in dialogs and remove transparency from all popout dialogs/forms

requirements.text: Enable the disabled “Add” tab/entry point wherever it appears in dialogs and dialog-driven workflows (e.g., any Tabs trigger/segment/button labeled “Add” that is currently disabled), so users can open the add/create form without being blocked.

quotes: add  tab is diabled in all dialog enable it and remove trancparency from all popout dialog box and forms and enable add tab

acceptanceCriteria: In every dialog or dialog-driven workflow where an “Add” tab/trigger exists, it is not disabled and can be selected/clicked.
Selecting the “Add” tab/trigger reliably reveals the add/create form content (no hidden/blocked state).
No console errors occur when switching to the “Add” tab/trigger.

requirements.text: Remove transparency from all popout dialog boxes and forms by ensuring dialog surfaces, popovers, and form containers use fully opaque theme colors (no Tailwind opacity modifiers like /10, /20, /50 and no translucent/backdrop-blur styling on dialog content). Apply this consistently across all dialogs (e.g., client/product/quotation/company/user management/confirm/print preview dialogs) and any nested popovers used inside dialogs (e.g., select dropdown content).

quotes: remove trancparency from all popout dialog box and forms

acceptanceCriteria: All dialog surfaces (DialogContent) render with fully opaque backgrounds in both light and dark modes.
No dialog/form/popover container classes include opacity modifiers (e.g., bg-*/50) or backdrop-blur/translucent effects.
Nested popovers used within dialogs (e.g., SelectContent) are also fully opaque and readable.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (Shadcn UI components must be composed, not modified).

Do not modify frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Backend must remain single-actor; no backend changes are required for these UI fixes.
nonGoals: Adding new backend data models or changing Motoko stable state.
Introducing new navigation patterns unrelated to enabling the existing “Add” tab/entry point.
